simple.meaning: עַנְתֹתִי (ʻAnthôthîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Antothite or inhabitant of Anathoth.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עַנְתֹתִי (H6069) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 23:27, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עַנְתֹתִי (H6069) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עַנְתֹתִי (H6069) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עַנְתֹתִי (ʻAnthôthîy) / H6069 is traced through 2 Samuel 23:27, 1 Chronicles 11:28, 1 Chronicles 12:3, 1 Chronicles 27:12 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
